subject: Urgent: BlueLine v5alpha rollout — p95 latency spike & hallucination reports (exec attention)
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@blueline.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
Cc: Lydia Cho <lydia.cho@blueline.com>, CloudOps SRE <sre@cloudops.io>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: v5alpha rollout — immediate production issues

Hi Aisha,

We pushed Redwood model v5alpha to 20% traffic at 02:00 PT this morning and started seeing a multi-region P95 latency spike (~2.3s -> 5.8s) and a concurrent increase in hallucination rate on user-facing completions (~0.7% -> 4.9%). Errors (5xx) also rose intermittently on POST /generate. This is affecting our customer chat flow and a small cohort is experiencing degraded UX.

Attached are a handful of request/response samples and client-side timings (blueline_error_samples.zip). Our SRE opened PD-98432. Can Redwood confirm whether the v5alpha quant profile was used for the rollout? We need an ETA on mitigation or rollback — product is asking for executive visibility.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Platform
BlueLine Financial

---

From: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, CloudOps SRE <sre@cloudops.io>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 08:29:00 -0700
Subject: Re: v5alpha rollout — immediate production issues

Samir — thanks for the samples and heads-up, we'll treat this as high priority. Quick notes/asks:

- We're spinning a triage bridge now (joining details in PD ticket).
- Can you confirm the traffic slice (20% variant A) and whether any request-level caching was enabled on your side?
- We see two likely root vectors — the v5alpha tokenization change that interacts poorly with the INT8 quant profile, and a new decoding guard we shipped that can add CPU-side latency under certain prompt shapes.

Action plan (initial):
1) Roll traffic to v4-stable for affected routes (we can flip the routing within ~8 minutes).
2) Collect server-side traces (we'll push a trace bundle to the Drive folder) and match against your samples.
3) If rollback resolves latency, we'll prepare an immediate hotfix release and schedule an after-action with engineering + BlueLine.

I'm escalating to Marissa and Rishi for exec coordination and timeline commitments. Standby for an invite to a 30-min bridge.

—Aisha
Aisha Rahman
VP, Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference

If rollback is low risk, authorize it now. Vanessa — prepare the standard credit/contract exception language in case Blueline requests relief.

Marissa Cole
Chief Customer Officer | Redwood Inference

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aisha_rahman@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@blueline.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: v5alpha rollout — immediate production issues

Short update for the bridge / execs:
- The rollout used the INT8-aggressive quant profile to reduce token costs for this cohort.
- Early server traces show elevated CPU context switches during decode on prompts with long system+history lengths; latency correlates with KV-cache misses triggered by a tokenization variance introduced in v5alpha.
- Error spike (5xx) looks like an internal decode timeout fallback after repeated retries.

Recommendation: immediate traffic reroute to v4-stable for the affected routes (low risk; stateful sessions will be respected). We'll do a canary of v4-stable at 5% and ramp to 100% if metrics normalize. If rollback normalizes both p95 and hallucination, we will:
  1) Block INT8-aggressive for v5alpha until we complete a compatibility pass.
  2) Ship a micro-patch removing the decoding guard that causes the CPU spikes within 72 hours.

I'll join the bridge and own postmortem write-up.

—Rishi Malhotra
VP, Inference Engineering | Redwood Inference

- Immediate: rollback maintained until Wednesday 27 Apr 2027 23:59 PT or until patch validated.
- Short: Rishi's team to reproduce the tokenization+INT8 interaction in our test harness and provide an RCA draft by EOD Monday.
- Exec: Marissa to schedule a 11:00 PT sync on Monday with BlueLine leadership to discuss timeline and commercial remediation if needed.
